messages.subject: išče se junior/senior dejta sajentist
parts:
Na linkedinu sem naletel na oglasi, ki bi bil morda primeren tudi za koga s te mailing liste. Morda pa poznate koga, ki bi ga ta tip dela zanimal?

https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/1513300237

Podjetje seveda klasično ne navede vseh pogojev dela, vključno z razponom za plačo. Ti ti.

Requested/Expected characteristics:
passionate about artificial intelligence and machine learning, any experience is appreciated
curious about constructing and training predictive models like neural networks, SVM, random forests etc.
basic knowledge of Statistics
some experience with computer programming, preferably Python or Node.js
experience with scientific programming, preferably Python or R, is a plus
experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, is a plus
good knowledge of Slovenian and English language
preferable Phd in Matematics
Tasks:
cleaning and processing large amounts of data, stored in relational and NoSQL databases or extracted from the web
text processing, classification and other kinds of text mining tasks, preferably with Python or Node.js
profiling users according to their behaviour on the web
user characterization/classification according to their profiles
 The job offers:
work in a young and innovative environment in a team of young professionals,
    cooperation in the fields of project development (big-data, artificial intelligence and behavior prediction models, including multimedia, web and mobile technologies)
tidy and relaxed work environment near BTC in Ljubljana
opportunities for ongoing professional and personal development.


lp,
Roman

--
In God we trust, all others bring data.
